audience.text: Developers building .NET services, desktop tools, or CLI utilities that require reading, creating, or inspecting Outlook MSG files, EML messages, and CFB containers without requiring Microsoft Outlook or third-party dependencies.

capabilities.text: Read and write Outlook .msg files at the MAPI level using MsgReader, MsgWriter, and MsgDocument, exposing property streams, recipient storages, and attachment sub-storages directly.
capabilities.title: Read and write MSG files

capabilities.text: Create, edit, save, and reload complete mutable message objects through MapiMessage with properties like Subject, Body, HtmlBody, SenderName, and SenderEmailAddress.
capabilities.title: Create and edit MapiMessage objects

capabilities.text: Open, traverse, and build Compound File Binary (CFB) containers programmatically using CfbReader, CfbWriter, CfbDocument, CfbStorage, and CfbStream.
capabilities.title: Process CFB containers

capabilities.text: Convert between MSG and EML formats natively without external MIME parsers using MapiMessage.LoadFromEml() and SaveToEml().
capabilities.title: Convert between MSG and EML

capabilities.text: Inspect parsing problems on loaded messages through the read-only ValidationIssues list populated when strict parsing encounters structural anomalies.
capabilities.title: Inspect parsing issues

capabilities.text: Attach recipients and files including nested embedded messages using AddRecipient(), AddAttachment(), and AddEmbeddedMessageAttachment().
capabilities.title: Attach recipients and files

capabilities.text: Set and read arbitrary MAPI properties beyond strongly-typed members using SetProperty() and GetPropertyValue() methods.
capabilities.title: Access arbitrary MAPI properties

capabilities.text: The library ships with no required third-party package dependencies; CFB, MSG, and EML/MIME handling are implemented natively.
capabilities.title: No external dependencies

limitations.text: No IMAP, SMTP, or POP3 support — this library reads and writes local files only and does not connect to mail servers.
No TNEF support — Transport Neutral Encapsulation Format (winmail.dat) is not parsed or generated.
No calendar or appointment support — calendar-specific MAPI properties can be accessed generically but there is no dedicated calendar API.
No .NET Framework support — requires .NET 8.0 or later; classic .NET Framework (4.x) is not supported.

problems_solved.text: Enables deterministic binary and message processing of Outlook MSG files, CFB containers, and EML data without external dependencies or Microsoft Outlook installation.
Provides native parsing and serialization of EML (RFC 5322/MIME) to MSG and vice versa without requiring external MIME parsers.
Supports forensic inspection and repair of MSG files by exposing raw MAPI property streams, recipient storages, and attachment sub-storages.
Offers programmatic CFB container creation and traversal for low-level access to compound file structures.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Email.Foss is a free, open-source .NET library for deterministic processing of email formats including MSG, EML, and CFB containers, with no external package dependencies.

workflows.name: Read MSG file subject
workflows.text: Load an MSG file using MapiMessage.FromFile() and access the Subject property to extract the message subject.

workflows.name: Create and save MSG message
workflows.text: Create a MapiMessage instance, set properties like Subject, Body, SenderName, and SenderEmailAddress, then persist using Save().

workflows.name: Convert EML to MSG
workflows.text: Parse an EML file into a MapiMessage using MapiMessage.LoadFromEml() and serialize it to MSG format using Save().

workflows.name: Inspect CFB container structure
workflows.text: Use CfbReader.FromFile() or CfbReader.FromStream() to open a CFB container and traverse its directory tree with IterStorages() and IterStreams().

workflows.name: Add recipients and attachments
workflows.text: Attach recipients using AddRecipient() and files using AddAttachment() or AddEmbeddedMessageAttachment() to a MapiMessage instance.

workflows.name: Set and read MAPI properties
workflows.text: Access arbitrary MAPI properties using SetProperty() and GetPropertyValue() beyond the strongly-typed MapiMessage members.
